question: In the morning, 237 cars were parked in the Central Street garage. By mid-morning 16 cars had driven out, and before lunch another 128 left. In the afternoon 23 cars arrived, and later 4 more pulled in. In the evening, every car still in the garage was charged 5 dollars for the day. How many dollars did the garage collect that evening?

In the morning, Greta's flower stall had 221 tulips, while Nils's stall across the square had 180. By late morning Greta had sold 208 tulips. In the afternoon a supplier brought her 20 more, she sold 26, and 2 wilted and were thrown away. In the evening she sold each remaining tulip for 6 kronor. How many kronor did Greta earn in the evening?

Maple Hill school has 223 students, but on exam day 91 of them are away on a field trip. Every student who sits the exam receives 2 booklets. Each booklet has 9 pages, and each page carries 4 questions. The exam takes up half a day. How many questions in total are printed in the booklets handed out?

In the morning Farid baked 118 loaves for his bakery and then baked a second batch of exactly the same size, doubling his stock, which was still fewer loaves than the 300 his rival Hamid had. A delivery van brought 47 loaves from his other branch. By noon he had sold 196 loaves. In the afternoon 18 loaves went stale and were removed. In the evening he baked 66 fresh loaves for the late customers. How many loaves did Farid have at closing time?

Jonas had 72 dollars in his wallet on Monday, and he tutors twice a week. He spent 16 dollars on lunch, then was paid 68 dollars for a tutoring session. He found 11 dollars in an old jacket and added it to his wallet. Later he spent 28 dollars on a book and 68 dollars on a new pair of shoes. He counts his loose change in cents but writes his ledger in dollars, since a hundred cents make one dollar. How many dollars does Jonas have in his wallet now?

The history shelf in the town library held 31 books on Monday, in a reading room with a dozen windows. On Tuesday 49 borrowed books were returned to the shelf. On Wednesday the librarian added 30 newly purchased books, and on Thursday a retired teacher donated 71 books to the shelf. On Friday 55 books were borrowed from it. On Saturday 3 misplaced books were found and put back on the shelf. How many books are on the history shelf now?

Bao and his cousin Lin are both saving for laptops. Bao puts 148 dollars into his savings jar in each of 6 months, while Lin saves a total of 900 dollars over the same period, so Lin has more. Bao's grandmother then adds 40 dollars to his jar. Bao takes 869 dollars out of the jar to buy his laptop. A week later he finds 9 dollars in a coat pocket and drops it into the jar. How many dollars are in Bao's jar now?

Kofi emptied his coin jar and counted 195 cents. He spent 21 cents on a piece of gum, then his sister paid him back 56 cents she owed him. He spent 34 cents on a sticker and 154 cents on a bus ticket for a ride that took 25 minutes. While waiting half an hour at the stop, he dropped 18 cents into a busker's hat. He usually thinks of his money in dollars rather than cents, since a hundred cents make one dollar. How many cents does Kofi have left?

Nora and Dev both collect loyalty points at the Corner Cafe. Nora's card showed 54 points, fewer than the 70 points on Dev's card. Nora earned 39 points on a large order, then spent 64 points on a free lunch, and later earned 28 points more. On the cafe's anniversary, every member's point balance was multiplied by 5 as a gift. Each point is worth one cent of credit, and Nora works out her credit in dollars, since a hundred cents make one dollar. How many points does Nora have now?

Raj is filling the empty water tank on his farm. His pump delivers 157 litres in each hour, and he runs it for 9 hours. An overnight rainstorm adds 50 litres through the roof gutters, and in the morning he tops the tank up with another 57 litres from a hose. He then draws 984 litres from the tank to irrigate the orchard. Raj records the tank level in litres, though the tank's gauge shows kilolitres, and a thousand litres make one kilolitre. How many litres are in the tank now?

A brickworks makes 140 bricks in every hour it runs, and half of its workers are apprentices. It runs for 8 hours each day and 5 days each week, and the current order takes 4 weeks. The yard already held 67 bricks before the order began, and they are added to the pile. When the pile is inspected, 972 bricks are found to be cracked and are removed. How many bricks are in the pile?

In the morning, a wholesaler delivered 9 crates of mangoes to the market, each crate holding 134 mangoes. In the afternoon a farmer brought 76 more mangoes, and a neighbouring stall passed over 43 that it could not fit on its shelves. In the evening a late van dropped off a final 62 mangoes. How many mangoes did the market receive that day?

In the morning, Ravi's print shop ran off 6 batches of 84 posters each, more than the 400 posters Sunita's shop printed that day. On checking, 17 smudged posters were thrown away. In the afternoon Ravi handed 42 posters to a cafe owner and delivered 396 to the music festival. In the evening he gave 30 posters to a school. How many posters did Ravi have left?

For each screening of the new film, the Lyric cinema sells 52 tickets online and 29 tickets at the door. The film, which runs for 112 minutes, is shown 6 times every day. In addition, 37 free passes are used at the cinema each day. This schedule continues for 5 days. How many people attend the film over the 5 days?

Sven, who has run his plant nursery for a dozen years, has 163 rosemary plants, more than the 140 plants his rival Astrid has. He raises 55 more from seed and buys 40 from a wholesaler. He then takes 4 cuttings from every plant he has. Of these cuttings, 151 fail to root, and Astrid gives him 45 rooted cuttings from her stock. He sells all his cuttings for 8 kronor each. How many kronor does Sven receive?

Dev is building a playlist for a party and tracks its length in minutes. The playlist starts at 160 minutes long. He removes 59 minutes of slow songs, then adds 38 minutes of dance tracks and another 52 minutes of pop songs. For the party, the finished playlist will be played from start to finish 9 times in a row. Dev keeps his notes in minutes rather than hours, even though sixty minutes make one hour. How many minutes of music will play at the party?

A stationery wholesaler packed 69 pens into each of 6 boxes to make one shipment, and sent 2 such shipments to a chain of shops. The chain divided all the pens equally among its 4 branches. The High Street branch sold 144 of its pens in the first week. It then put every remaining pen on sale at 5 dollars each and sold them all, and it also earned 65 dollars from selling notebooks. The branch's till counts in cents, and the manager converts the total to dollars, since a hundred cents make one dollar. How many dollars did the High Street branch take in from the pens and notebooks together?

In the morning the foreman at a bolt factory starts up 7 machines, each of which makes 209 bolts in an hour, along with an old hand press that adds 70 bolts in an hour. In the afternoon the whole setup runs for exactly 5 hours, and the factory repeats this same schedule on each of 6 days to fill an order. In the evening of the last day, the foreman adds 77 bolts from the storeroom to the order. Each machine cost 1200 dollars when it was bought. How many bolts are in the order?

In the morning, Lucia's warehouse crew had 224 parcels waiting for dispatch, more than the 200 parcels waiting at Marco's warehouse. By midday 39 of Lucia's parcels had been collected by a courier. In the afternoon the crew weighed the rest: each remaining parcel weighed 3 kilograms, and the crew added 26 kilograms of packing material to the load. In the evening the freight company charged 2 dollars for every kilogram of the load. How many dollars did the freight company charge?

Petra had 125 raffle tickets to sell for her club, more than the 100 tickets her friend Jan had. The club gave her 20 more tickets, and later another 79. She sold 221 tickets. For every ticket she still held, the club gave her 5 tokens as a reward, and she spent 9 tokens on a hot drink. Each of her remaining tokens could be exchanged for 6 cents. How many cents did Petra get for her remaining tokens?

Kai keeps a reading log in minutes for a book that has 320 pages. On Monday he read for 110 minutes. On Tuesday he read for 63 minutes, on Wednesday for 54 minutes, on Thursday for 62 minutes, on Friday for 18 minutes, and on Saturday for just 7 minutes. His teacher asks for the log in hours, and Kai knows that sixty minutes make one hour, but he keeps his own total in minutes. How many minutes did Kai read in total that week?

In the morning, 152 people had registered for the town's street festival, and 6 more registered at the gate. In the afternoon, every registered person turned up as part of a group of 8, so the crowd was 8 times the number of registrations. The parade lasted 45 minutes. Before the evening concert, 1055 people went home. During the concert the crowd tripled as the rest of the town arrived. How many people were at the festival by the end of the concert?

A summer camp had 201 children signed up, but 139 of them were away on a hike when the treats were handed out. Each child present was given 8 sweets. The camp leader then doubled every child's share because it was the last day. She also set aside 72 sweets in a jar for later. The sweets are sold to the camp by the kilogram, though the leader counts them in grams, and a thousand grams make one kilogram. How many sweets did the camp leader hand out and set aside altogether?

A fruit importer received 38 boxes of oranges, and a dozen volunteers helped unload them. Each box held 8 bags, and each bag contained 4 oranges. The importer also had 71 loose oranges left over from a previous delivery. All of the oranges were then shared equally among 3 schools, one of which was Hill School. How many oranges did Hill School receive?

In the morning, each of the 7 delivery vans at a dairy is loaded with 169 crates of milk, and then 5 extra crates are added to each van; half of the vans are electric. In the afternoon, the depot, which is 12 kilometres from the dairy, receives all these crates, plus 46 crates from a second dairy and 40 crates from a third. In the evening the depot unpacks everything, and each crate holds 6 bottles. How many bottles does the depot unpack?
